project_type: npm-workspaces TypeScript monorepo: @mlb/shared (domain types + seed + pure logic), @mlb/backend (API Gateway HTTP API Lambdas + DynamoDB + Bedrock), @mlb/frontend (React + Vite SPA on S3+CloudFront), @mlb/infra (AWS CDK).
language: TypeScript (strict, ESM, Node 20 Lambda target; local toolchain Node 22).
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts: build (ordered shared->backend->frontend->infra), test (vitest per workspace), synth (cdk synth), test:e2e (Playwright, frontend). node/npm NOT on PATH by default: prefix with PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH".
test_framework: Vitest unit + *.property.test.ts (fast-check) + Playwright e2e in frontend/e2e. AWS SDK and MLB API are always mocked; no live calls.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build (ordered). 2) npm test (all workspaces vitest). 3) npm run synth (cdk synth, no AWS calls). 4) npm run test:e2e -w frontend (Playwright headless chromium --no-sandbox; may need `npx playwright install chromium` once). Keep all three green; do NOT run cdk deploy; no live Bedrock/MLB calls.
snapshot_or_generated_files: cdk.out from `npm run synth` (gitignored). No committed snapshots. frontend/dist built by vite. Playwright test-results gitignored.
setup_instructions: npm ci already done (node_modules present). Ensure PATH includes node 22.23.3 bin. For e2e: `PATH=... npx playwright install chromium` once if browser missing.
environment_constraints: No cdk deploy, no live AWS/Bedrock/MLB. The OG image Lambda must NOT depend on native binaries (sharp has native .node binaries that are risky under esbuild/NodejsFunction bundling and may not run in the sandbox for tests) -> generate deterministic SVG via a pure tested builder. Document honestly that some crawlers do not render SVG og:image.
contribution_requirements: .kiro/steering is inclusion:always: make INCREMENTAL commits per feature on branch feat/mlb-postseason-site (conventional commits, scope issue-21); keep specs/README truthful - update .kiro/specs/mlb-postseason/{requirements,design,tasks}.md AND both README.md + README.ja.md; spec-driven dev is graded. Do NOT push, open PRs, or deploy (orchestrator owns that).
key_patterns: Pure tested builders live in shared/ or workspace src with colocated *.test.ts. Backend handlers in backend/src/handlers/<action>.ts use jsonResponse/CORS from http.ts and a BracketService; parse query via http.ts helpers; return discriminated unions at HTTP 200 (see getGameDetail). DynamoBracketStore in backend/src/store/dynamo.ts caches by pk string with numeric ttl; getCached*/putCached* no-op when TABLE_NAME unset. CDK stack infra/lib/mlb-postseason-stack.ts: NodejsFunction ESM node20, externalModules ['@aws-sdk/*']; getGameDetailFn is the no-Bedrock template to copy (only TABLE_NAME env, grantReadWriteData, NO bedrock policy). CloudFront serves SPA with 403/404->/index.html rewrite. i18n is a flat MessageKey dictionary in frontend/src/i18n/messages.ts (ja+en), default ja, persisted mlb.lang; useI18n() gives {lang,setLang,t}. Team brand colors in frontend/src/teamColors.ts (need a shared equivalent for the backend OG builder). predict() lives in @mlb/shared (pure).
directory_structure: shared/src (types, predict, seed, accuracy, narrative, integrity, backtest). backend/src/{handlers,service,store,mlb,predict,bedrock,metrics}. frontend/src/{pages,components,i18n,assets} + e2e/. infra/{lib,test}.
